messages:
Priya (Support): FYI customer acme-uk reporting SIEM stopped getting audit events around 2026-02-15T01:03Z. They see sequence gaps (seq 34213-34217) and manifest shows chunk-03 missing. attaching their manifest id manifest-0a7d :eyes:

Ethan (Support): Oof. Do we have forwarder logs or any KMS/HSM errors? Which export mode (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Priya (Support): They're on Dedicated in eu-west-1. Asked customer for forwarder logs and their SIEM ingest snapshots. They sent a gzipped log bundle and the manifest pointer.

Luca (eng-security): Quick peek at the supplied forwarder log excerpt: `WARN hsm-queue timeout reencrypt=1200ms tenant=acme-uk chunk=chunk-03` then `ERROR export failed: missing-seq-range 34213-34217`. Looks like re-encrypt step timed out and the chunk never made it to S3.

Sam (eng-runtime): Paging ops-bot for exporter metrics at that window. ops-bot, can you attach the metric snapshot around 2026-02-15T01:00Z-01:10Z?

ops-bot: exporter.reencrypt.queue_length=27; exporter.reencrypt.timeouts=3; exporter.s3.put_retries=0; exporter.process.uptime=12d

Sam (eng-runtime): 27 queue length is high. On older Dedicated forwarder images we had `exporter.max_retries=2` and `drop_on_retries=true` — combined with HSM latency spikes that can cause chunks to be dropped instead of queued for replay.

Priya (Support): Customer says they didn't see any errors on their SIEM side, just missing sequences. They're willing to let us run a replay/backfill if we provide steps.

Luca (eng-security): Action items: 1) collect full forwarder logs for 01:00-01:10Z, 2) grab S3 manifest versions and s3 access logs for manifest-0a7d, 3) reproduce locally to verify policy. Priya — can you upload bundles to #private-artifacts and grant Sam/Luca access?

Priya (Support): Uploaded logs to #private-artifacts (manifest-0a7d, forwarder-logs-20260215.gz). Notified customer we'll proceed with replay if repro confirmed.

Sam (eng-runtime): I repro'd this by simulating HSM latency >1s with exporter.max_retries=2. Repro steps below — reproduces `drop chunk` behaviour.

```bash
# simulate slow HSM and run forwarder in dry-run
export HSM_SIMULATE_LATENCY_MS=1200
./exporter --tenant acme-uk --manifest manifest-0a7d --dry-run
# observe logs for 'drop chunk' messages
grep -E "drop chunk|missing-seq|reencrypt timeout" exporter.log
```

Luca (eng-security): Root cause appears to be HSM latency spike + conservative retry policy on older Dedicated forwarder. Mitigations: bump `exporter.max_retries` to 5, set `drop_on_retries=false`, and add a backoff jitter. Also add alert for `reencrypt.queue_length>10`.

Sam (eng-runtime): I'll open an infra PR to change defaults for Dedicated images and deploy a config override for affected tenants. I'll also add a short-lived replay job to backfill the missing sequences for manifest-0a7d.

Priya (Support): Customer agreed to replay. I initiated replay runbook per internal guide https://redwood.internal/runbooks/export-replay and scheduled it during their maintenance window. Notified them to confirm once SIEM indexes are restored. :lock:

Sam (eng-runtime): Replay complete, job id replay-20260215-01-45, logs show chunks 03-05 re-ingested to S3. Will keep an eye on retry/error metrics for the next 24h.

Priya (Support): Customer confirmed they see the missing events in QRadar and sequences 34213-34217 are present again. Closing on customer side but leaving infra follow-ups open (PR/alert) assigned to @Sam and @Luca. :thumbsup:
